import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    ch = s[0]
    s = s[1:]
    s = s.replace("at", "@", 1)
    while True:
        pos = s.find("dot")
        if pos == -1:
            break
        if pos == len(s) - 3:
            break
        s = s[:pos] + "." + s[pos+3:]
    print(ch + s, end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
